options.name: address
options.description: Parameter introduced in Zabbix 7.0. IP address or DNS name to connect to. Required if the Zabbix proxy operating mode is passive

options.name: allowed_addresses
options.description: Parameter introduced in Zabbix 7.0. Comma-delimited IP addresses or DNS names of active Zabbix proxy.

options.name: ca_cert
options.description: Certificate issuer.

options.name: custom_timeouts
options.description: Parameter introduced in Zabbix 7.0. Whether to override global item timeouts on the proxy level. 0 - use global settings; 1 - override timeouts.

options.name: description
options.description: Description of the proxy.

options.name: http_login_password
options.description: Basic Auth password

options.name: http_login_user
options.description: Basic Auth login

options.name: interface
options.description: Deprecated for Zabbix version >= 7.0. Dictionary with params for the interface when proxy is in passive mode. For more information, review proxy interface documentation at U(https://www.zabbix.com/documentation/current/en/manual/api/reference/proxy/object#proxy-interface).

options.name: local_address
options.description: Parameter introduced in Zabbix 7.0. Address for active agents. IP address or DNS name to connect to. Required if proxy_groupid is not 0

options.name: local_port
options.description: Parameter introduced in Zabbix 7.0. Local proxy port number to connect to. Supported if proxy_groupid is not 0

options.name: operating_mode
options.description: Parameter introduced in Zabbix 7.0. Type of proxy.

options.name: port
options.description: Parameter introduced in Zabbix 7.0. Port number to connect to. supported if the Zabbix proxy operating mode is passive.

options.name: proxy_address
options.description: Deprecated for Zabbix version >= 7.0. Comma-delimited list of IP/CIDR addresses or DNS names to accept active proxy requests from. Requires I(status=active).

options.name: proxy_group
options.description: Parameter introduced in Zabbix 7.0. Proxy group name.

options.name: proxy_name
options.description: Name of the proxy in Zabbix.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the proxy. On C(present), it will create if proxy does not exist or update the proxy if the associated data is different. On C(absent) will remove a proxy if it exists.

options.name: status
options.description: Deprecated for Zabbix version >= 7.0. Type of proxy. (4 - active, 5 - passive)

options.name: timeout_browser
options.description: Parameter introduced in Zabbix 7.0. Spend no more than this number of seconds on browser type checks processing. Accepts seconds or time unit with suffix (e.g., 30s, 1m). Possible values range: 1-600s. Required if if C(custom_timeouts) is set to 1.

options.name: timeout_db_monitor
options.description: Parameter introduced in Zabbix 7.0. Spend no more than this number of seconds on DB checks processing. Accepts seconds or time unit with suffix (e.g., 30s, 1m). Possible values range: 1-600s. Required if if C(custom_timeouts) is set to 1.

options.name: timeout_external_check
options.description: Parameter introduced in Zabbix 7.0. Spend no more than this number of seconds on external checks processing. Accepts seconds or time unit with suffix (e.g., 30s, 1m). Possible values range: 1-600s. Required if if C(custom_timeouts) is set to 1.

options.name: timeout_http_agent
options.description: Parameter introduced in Zabbix 7.0. Spend no more than this number of seconds on HTTPagent checks processing. Accepts seconds or time unit with suffix (e.g., 30s, 1m). Possible values range: 1-600s. Required if if C(custom_timeouts) is set to 1.

options.name: timeout_script
options.description: Parameter introduced in Zabbix 7.0. Spend no more than this number of seconds on script type checks processing. Accepts seconds or time unit with suffix (e.g., 30s, 1m). Possible values range: 1-600s. Required if if C(custom_timeouts) is set to 1.

options.name: timeout_simple_check
options.description: Parameter introduced in Zabbix 7.0. Spend no more than this number of seconds on simple checks processing. Accepts seconds or time unit with suffix (e.g., 30s, 1m). Possible values range: 1-600s. Required if if C(custom_timeouts) is set to 1.

options.name: timeout_snmp_agent
options.description: Parameter introduced in Zabbix 7.0. Spend no more than this number of seconds on SNMP agent checks processing. Accepts seconds or time unit with suffix (e.g., 30s, 1m). Possible values range: 1-600s. Required if if C(custom_timeouts) is set to 1.

options.name: timeout_ssh_agent
options.description: Parameter introduced in Zabbix 7.0. Spend no more than this number of seconds on SSH checks processing. Accepts seconds or time unit with suffix (e.g., 30s, 1m). Possible values range: 1-600s. Required if if C(custom_timeouts) is set to 1.

options.name: timeout_telnet_agent
options.description: Parameter introduced in Zabbix 7.0. Spend no more than this number of seconds on Telnet checks processing. Accepts seconds or time unit with suffix (e.g., 30s, 1m). Possible values range: 1-600s. Required if if C(custom_timeouts) is set to 1.

options.name: timeout_zabbix_agent
options.description: Parameter introduced in Zabbix 7.0. Spend no more than this number of seconds on Zabbix agent checks processing. Accepts seconds or time unit with suffix (e.g., 30s, 1m). Possible values range: 1-600s. Rired if if C(custom_timeouts) is set to 1.

options.name: tls_accept
options.description: Connections from proxy.

options.name: tls_connect
options.description: Connections to proxy.

options.name: tls_psk
options.description: The preshared key, at least 32 hex digits. Required if either I(tls_connect) or I(tls_accept) has PSK enabled.

options.name: tls_psk_identity
options.description: PSK identity. Required if either I(tls_connect) or I(tls_accept) has PSK enabled.

options.name: tls_subject
options.description: Certificate subject.
